# TikZ oracle comparison (generated by `tools/tikz-oracle/compare.py`)

pdflatex is the oracle only; the FlashTeX side is `flashtex-tikz-pdf`
(no TeX). Method and tolerance: see the docstring of `compare.py`.

- reference: pdfTeX 3.141592653-2.6-1.40.29 (TeX Live 2026) (standalone class, `border=5pt`, T1 + lmodern)
- rasteriser: Ghostscript 10.07.1, 150 dpi, 4-bit anti-aliasing
- pixel threshold: 64/255 per channel; PASS = page size within 1 px and tolerant (3x3) mismatch <= 1.0% of ink pixels
